questions.question: The volumetric efficiency versus engine speed for various intake manifold configurations of an automotive four-stroke engine __ using the computer simulation based on thermodynamic modeling.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 The volumetric efficiency，空格要放主要動詞。「效率可以被評估」用 can be evaluated（can＋be＋過去分詞）。

questions.question: __ pumping the fresh charge into the cylinders may be minimized by varying the amount of fuel injected per cycle with the air flow through the throttle.
questions.explanation: 句中已有動詞 may be minimized，前面只缺主詞 The negative work。pumping… 是補充這項功的內容，不用再加連接詞。

questions.question: The technology of mobile computing is designed __ meet human demands ranging from business and government to social contacts.
questions.explanation: 固定用法 be designed to＋原形動詞，表示「被設計用來……」，所以填 to meet。

questions.question: The greatest problem confronting people today __ to transform other forms of energy into electrical energy.
questions.explanation: 主詞的核心是單數 problem，所以動詞用 is。confronting people today 只是修飾 problem。

questions.question: In these circumstances __ due to acceleration acts rearwards through the vehicle center of gravity with its magnitude equal to the tractive forces existing between the tires of the driven wheels and the road.
questions.explanation: 句首 In these circumstances 是背景，真正主詞為 an inertia force，後面 acts 是動詞。直接填名詞即可。

questions.question: The bluetooth technology initially studied __ by Ericsson in 1994 has been developed to operate in a wireless and short-distance environment, providing the transmissions of voice and data.
questions.explanation: for＋名詞表示「為了……用途」，for mobile phone application 修飾 studied。主要動詞是後面的 has been developed。

questions.question: Using General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) based on existing GSM networks, customers __ on to Internet, and only have to pay for these services on sending or receiving information.
questions.explanation: 主詞 customers 後面需要動詞。「保持登入狀態」用 be logged on，所以選 can be permanently logged。記住 can 後接原形 be。

questions.question: Today the computer is widely used in solving mathematical problems __ to do with weather forecasting and putting satellites into orbit.
questions.explanation: having to do with＝「與……有關」，修飾前面的 problems。可理解成 problems which have to do with…。

questions.question: An amplifying medium for lasers located in a cavity between two mirrors __ the intensity of light beam passing through it.
questions.explanation: 主詞核心是 medium，located… 是修飾語；句子缺主要動詞，因此用 can increase。can 後接原形動詞。

questions.question: The butterfly valve mounted at the upstream end of the intake system __ to control the amount of air flow induced into an SI engine.
questions.explanation: 「閥門被用來控制……」用 is used to control。mounted… 是修飾 valve，不是整句的主要動詞。

questions.question: Forming a rectangular figure eight with both coils concentrically mounted on the middle leg, __ is called a shell-type transformer.
questions.explanation: 後面已有 is called，前面需要主詞 the core。句首 Forming… 是補充 core 的形狀。

questions.question: The CIS-E Motronic engine management system can monitor the intake air temperature sensor to detect EGR system faults __ in permanent memory of the built-in diagnostic circuitry.
questions.explanation: faults 是「被儲存」的故障資訊，用過去分詞 stored 修飾；可還原成 faults which are stored…。

questions.question: Any sideways push exerted by the kerb __ steered to this modest degree can then be absorbed by the flexibility of the tire wall and suspension bushings.
questions.explanation: 句子主幹是 Any sideways push… can then be absorbed。against the rear wheels 表示「作用在後輪上」，不用另加動詞。

questions.question: The effectiveness of translation from the driving torque applied to the wheels into a tractive force to propel the vehicle __ on the vertical load and the coefficient of friction existing between the tires and road.
questions.explanation: 主詞核心是單數 effectiveness，空格要放主要動詞 depends。depend on＝「取決於」。

questions.question: The vaporization of fuel occurring in the cylinder __ of the compression stroke cools the air for increasing the amount of charge induced from the intake manifold.
questions.explanation: 句子已有主要動詞 cools，只需補「在壓縮衝程的後期」這個時間片語：at a late stage。

questions.question: The effect of this inertia force acting at the height of the center of gravity is __ a pitching couple on the car, thus increasing the load on the rear wheels and reducing it on the front ones.
questions.explanation: 主幹是 The effect… is to impose…，用 to＋原形動詞說明作用：施加一個俯仰力偶。

questions.question: Heat transfer from the gas can be coupled to the conduction analysis __ for capacitance only in a layer of thickness in series with a resistance measured for a steady state.
questions.explanation: accounting for… 用來修飾 conduction analysis，表示「把……納入考量」。主動關係用 V-ing，主要動詞已有 can be coupled。

questions.question: The two-stroke engine operating at 2000 rpm and made of cast iron __ a small amplitude of the oscillation formed inside the surface of the cylinder block.
questions.explanation: 主詞核心是單數 engine，所以主要動詞用 gives。operating… 和 made… 都是修飾語；can gives 錯在 can 後未用原形。

questions.question: In the simplest case of a four-wheel-drive vehicle having an equal distribution of weight between the front and rear wheels, __ of driving torque between its axles would seem to be acceptable.
questions.explanation: 句首 In… 是背景，would seem 前面需要主詞 an equal division。不要被前面的長片語干擾。

questions.question: A star configuration __ of a series of computers connected through a central point with a device served as a knob.
questions.explanation: 主詞 A star configuration 是單數，選 comprises。提醒：原句 comprises of 用法不標準；正確通常寫 comprises a series… 或 is composed of a series…。依原選項仍選 A。

questions.question: Computer and information systems accepted by the general public __ for specialized activities are on the verge of astonishing advance, generally called the "information revolution".
questions.explanation: accepted… as…＝「被接受為／被視為……」。主要動詞已有 are，所以選 as…，不用再加 is 或 are。提醒：原文 an useful tool 應為 a useful tool。

questions.question: Charged particles trapped inside our planet's magnetic field make up the Van Allen radiation belts __ almost 20,000 kilometers above Earth.
questions.explanation: belts 是「位於」地球上方，用 located 修飾，可理解為 belts which are located…。主要動詞已有 make up。

questions.question: The air introduced by the solenoid __ in addition to the air admitted by the fixed air bleeds.
questions.explanation: 主詞核心是不可數名詞 air，視為單數，所以用 is。introduced by the solenoid 只是修飾 air。

questions.question: The amount of vacuum applied to the servo is modulated using the cruise control power valve __ by the engine control module.
questions.explanation: valve 是「被控制」的，用 governed 修飾；可還原成 valve which is governed by…。主要動詞已有 is modulated。

questions.question: In some cases, information __ within the engine control module is sent by way of a data link to the body computer module as input information.
questions.explanation: information 是「被包含／儲存在」模組內，用 contained 修飾。整句主要動詞是 is sent，不能直接再加 is contained。

questions.question: The hole in the disk __ transmission of light through the light pipes from the light-emitting diode source to the phototransistor used as a light sensor.
questions.explanation: 主詞核心是單數 hole，因此主要動詞用 allows。can allows 錯在 can 後面必須用原形 allow。

questions.question: The voltage developed across the sensors results from the electromagnetic forces acting on electrons in metal __.
questions.explanation: metal and semiconductors 是兩個並列名詞，表示「金屬與半導體」。整句已有 results，不需要再補 is 或 are。

questions.question: Above the 8th floor, __ and inclined moment-resisting lattices holding a wall system of glass panels all tie back into the super-columns in order to counter both wind and seismic activity without being damaged.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 steel trusses and inclined… lattices，兩者共同搭配後面的 tie。空格只需放 steel trusses，不加連接詞或介系詞。

questions.question: An inertia force acting rearwards __ of gravity due to acceleration is equal in magnitude to the tractive forces existing between the tires of the wheels and the road.
questions.explanation: 整句主要動詞已有 is equal，空格只需補 through the vehicle center of gravity，表示「通過車輛重心」。

questions.question: To find the subsequent height of the feet above the baseline drawn through their initial position, __ in column 4 are added together algebraically one after the other, giving the values in column 5.
questions.explanation: 後面 are added 是動詞，前面需補主詞 the values。in column 4 修飾 values，表示第 4 欄中的數值。

questions.question: The process usually __ taking thousands of images from videos featuring the faces of the target and the actor from different angles.
questions.explanation: 主詞 The process 是單數，動詞用 involves。固定搭配 involve＋V-ing，表示「涉及／包含做某事」。

questions.question: The revenue __ by e-sports as a whole has also grown rapidly in recent times, now totaling $650 million per year and expected to climb to $4 billion by 2022.
questions.explanation: revenue 是「被電競產生」的收入，所以用 generated 修飾。主要動詞是後面的 has also grown。

questions.question: The oxygen sensor does not function __ reaches a rather high operating temperature, so, on some later models, a heater unit may be included to bring the sensor into operation quickly.
questions.explanation: 固定句型 not… until…＝「直到……才……」。意思是感測器直到達到高溫才會運作；until 後接 it reaches… 完整子句。

questions.question: The concave eyepiece lens, or diverging lens, curves inward __ the image so that it spreads across the human retina to create a larger image than possible with just the human eye.
questions.explanation: 同一主詞 lens 做兩個動作：curves inward and magnifies…。用 and 連接，兩個動詞都用第三人稱單數。

questions.question: The recognition that __ of happiness and unhappiness can coexist much like love and hate in a close relationship may offer valuable clues on how to lead a happier life.
questions.explanation: that 後面需接完整子句，空格要放主詞，四個選項只有名詞 feeling 可用。此處指幸福與不幸福的感受能共存；原句用 feelings 會更自然。

questions.question: What the economic theories can contribute to the management science __ building analytical models which help in recognizing the structure of managerial problem, and eliminating the minor details which might obstruct decision making.
questions.explanation: What… can contribute… 整段當主詞，後面需要主要動詞 is。is building analytical models 表示「貢獻在於建立分析模型」，此處 building 是動名詞。

questions.question: Food biotechnology will continue to make a significant impact on the global community, as long as research and development makes every effort to keep the public trust, provide economic fairness, __ the health of the ecosystem.
questions.explanation: keep、provide、protect 是三個並列動作：to keep… , provide… , and protect…。共用前面的 to，最後只需 and protect。

questions.question: Water supply can be naturally affected by climate, drought, and floods, but problems with misallocation of water resources, pollution of water sources, and difficulty __ and developing available water contribute to growing water crisis in the 21st century.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 difficulty in＋V-ing＝「在做某事上有困難」。因此用 in accessing，並與後面的 developing 並列。

questions.question: A comparison of the skeletal structure of the two species reveals similarities such as hollow bones, while examination of their cellular anatomy indicates __ are directly related.
questions.explanation: indicates that＋完整句子＝「顯示……」。that they are directly related 中，they 是主詞，are 是動詞。

questions.question: Even though plenty of surveys indicate that the firstborns are out-performed among children, this declaration really says less __ the eldest than about not having many sibling, or living in an extended family.
questions.explanation: 比較結構 less about A than about B＝「與其說是關於 A，不如說是關於 B」。about 是介系詞，後接 being。

questions.question: Whether a later model has a heated sensor or not can be identified by noting __ has three wires in the connector.
questions.explanation: noting that＋完整句子，表示「注意到……」。that it has three wires 是 noting 的受詞內容。

questions.question: Theoretically the fact that the tractive forces are shared between four, rather than two, driven wheels should mean that a four-wheel-drive car can be accelerated harder out of a corner before __ loses its adhesion.
questions.explanation: before 是連接詞，後面直接接完整句子 any tire loses its adhesion。any tire 是主詞，不需要再加 when 或 that。

questions.question: Since installing optical fiber for each home is very expensive, a technology called ADSL which utilizes traditional network __ services similar to cable-modem system is developed to give minimal cost of installation and boost the telephone network to Internet application.
questions.explanation: to offer＋受詞表示目的：「利用傳統網路來提供服務」。to 後面必須接原形 offer。

questions.question: For the EGR system to operate properly, the vacuum hoses __ at the intake system must be securely connected so that the air induced from outside can be free of leak.
questions.explanation: hoses 是「位於」進氣系統的軟管，用 located 修飾。整句主要動詞是 must be securely connected。

questions.question: One typical example of major takeover conducted by this company __ people an understanding of how management mistakes combined with angry retaliation from the buyer can harm each other.
questions.explanation: 主詞核心是單數 example，所以主要動詞用 gives。conducted by this company 只是修飾 takeover；can gives 不符合 can＋原形。

questions.question: An oscillator usually requires a vacuum-tube or transistor amplifier providing an amplified in-phase output which is then fed back to the input __ oscillation.
questions.explanation: to sustain oscillation 表示目的：「為了維持振盪」。前面已有 is then fed back，不需再補一個 is。

questions.question: Drain-water heat recovery systems can capture hot water that __ down the drain, carrying with it most of the energy used to heat water in a home.
questions.explanation: that 引導關係子句，修飾 hot water；that 後面缺動詞，所以填 goes。water 視為單數，動詞加 -es。

questions.question: This assembly of closely spaced discs is sealed within the outer shell, which is almost completely filled with silicone fluid __ a viscosity about that of honey and remaining stable under wide variation in operating temperature.
questions.explanation: having… and remaining… 並列修飾 silicone fluid，表示「具有……且保持穩定」。主要動詞已有 is filled，不再直接加 has。

questions.question: Fiber optics coupled with the recent invention of Integrated Services Digital Network systems, which allow various machines __ and communicate with each other regardless of data type or computer language, will create an information superhighway.
questions.explanation: 固定句型 allow＋受詞＋to V，表示「允許／使……能夠……」。所以是 allow various machines to understand and communicate…。

questions.question: Software encompasses not only "application" programs, which present a business or scientific problem in a form a computer can understand, but also the great variety of detailed and voluminous instructions stored in computer memory __ and automate the work of the machine.
questions.explanation: to organize and automate… 表示這些指令的用途：「用來組織並自動執行機器工作」。to 後接原形，organize 與 automate 並列。
